nodes.description: ERC20 mapping(address=>uint256) _balances holding token balances of each account
ERC20 nested mapping _allowances[owner][spender] holding approved spend amounts
ERC20 uint256 _totalSupply tracking total minted token supply
ERC20 string _name with the token name
ERC20 string _symbol with the token symbol
GeneratorCopyright constant string _GENERATOR holding the generator URL
GeneratorCopyright string _version holding the generator version
ERC20 internal _transfer(address sender,address recipient,uint256 amount) moving balances and emitting Transfer
ERC20 internal _mint(address account,uint256 amount) creating tokens and increasing total supply
ERC20 internal _burn(address account,uint256 amount) destroying tokens and decreasing total supply
ERC20 internal _approve(address owner,address spender,uint256 amount) writing the allowance mapping
Public ERC20 transfer(address recipient,uint256 amount) forwarding to _transfer with _msgSender()
Public ERC20 transferFrom(address sender,address recipient,uint256 amount) moving tokens using allowance
Public ERC20 approve(address spender,uint256 amount) forwarding to _approve with _msgSender()
Public ERC20 increaseAllowance(address spender,uint256 addedValue) adding to current allowance
Public ERC20 decreaseAllowance(address spender,uint256 subtractedValue) subtracting from current allowance
Context internal _msgSender() returning msg.sender as the execution context sender
SimpleERC20 payable constructor validating initialBalance_ then minting to _msgSender()
ServicePayer payable constructor performing an external IPayable(receiver).pay call with msg.value
IPayable interface function pay(string serviceName) payable called by the ServicePayer constructor
msg.sender, attacker controllable caller address used as mint recipient and transfer sender
External value call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) made to an arbitrary receiver address
Balance arithmetic in _transfer: senderBalance - amount and _balances[recipient] += amount
Supply arithmetic in _mint: _totalSupply += amount and _balances[account] += amount
Supply arithmetic in _burn: accountBalance - amount and _totalSupply -= amount
Allowance arithmetic in increaseAllowance: existing allowance + addedValue
Allowance arithmetic in transferFrom: currentAllowance - amount

edges.reason: msg.sender is the value returned by Context._msgSender()
_msgSender() supplies the sender address used by transfer()
_msgSender() supplies the spender address used for allowance lookup in transferFrom()
_msgSender() supplies the owner address used by approve()
_msgSender() supplies the owner address used by increaseAllowance()
_msgSender() supplies the owner address used by decreaseAllowance()
constructor mints the initial balance to msg.sender via _mint(_msgSender(), initialBalance_)
SimpleERC20 constructor calls ERC20._mint to create the initial supply
initialBalance_ parameter is the minted amount passed to _mint
constructor parameter name_ is assigned to state variable _name
constructor parameter symbol_ is assigned to state variable _symbol
name_ is forwarded to the ERC20 base constructor from the SimpleERC20 constructor
symbol_ is forwarded to the ERC20 base constructor from the SimpleERC20 constructor
feeReceiver_ is passed as the receiver argument to the ServicePayer constructor
ServicePayer constructor performs the external value call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName)
the external pay call executes attacker-controlled code that can re-enter before the constructor finishes
receiver parameter is the arbitrary target address of the external pay call
serviceName parameter is passed as calldata into the external pay call
transfer() delegates the state mutation to _transfer
recipient parameter of transfer() is forwarded to _transfer
amount parameter of transfer() is forwarded to _transfer
sender parameter is used to index the _balances mapping inside _transfer
recipient parameter is used to credit tokens inside _transfer
amount parameter is validated and applied inside _transfer
_transfer reads _balances[sender] into the local senderBalance
local senderBalance participates in the senderBalance - amount subtraction
amount parameter is the subtrahend in the balance arithmetic of _transfer
arithmetic in _transfer writes back the updated values into the _balances mapping
_mint performs _totalSupply += amount and _balances[account] += amount
amount parameter is the addend in the mint arithmetic
_mint increases the _totalSupply state variable
_mint credits the recipient balance in the _balances mapping
account parameter is the credited address inside _mint
_burn performs accountBalance - amount and _totalSupply -= amount
account parameter is the debited address inside _burn
amount parameter is the subtrahend in the burn arithmetic
_burn reads _balances[account] into the local accountBalance
local accountBalance participates in the accountBalance - amount subtraction
burn arithmetic decreases the _totalSupply state variable
transferFrom() delegates the token movement to _transfer
sender parameter is the debited account in transferFrom
recipient parameter is the credited account in transferFrom
amount parameter is the value moved and checked against the allowance
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] into the local currentAllowance
local currentAllowance is the minuend in currentAllowance - amount
amount parameter is the subtrahend in the allowance reduction arithmetic
transferFrom reads and rewrites the _allowances mapping
allowance arithmetic result is written back into _allowances via _approve
approve() delegates the allowance write to _approve
spender parameter of approve() is forwarded to _approve
amount parameter of approve() is forwarded to _approve
owner parameter indexes the _allowances mapping inside _approve
spender parameter indexes the _allowances mapping inside _approve
amount parameter is stored as the new allowance inside _approve
_approve writes the allowance into the _allowances state variable
increaseAllowance computes _allowances[_msgSender()][spender] + addedValue
spender parameter selects the allowance slot in increaseAllowance
addedValue parameter is the addend in the allowance increase arithmetic
increaseAllowance updates the _allowances state variable
decreaseAllowance reads _allowances[_msgSender()][spender] into local currentAllowance
decreaseAllowance performs currentAllowance - subtractedValue
spender parameter selects the allowance slot in decreaseAllowance
subtractedValue parameter is the subtrahend in the allowance decrease arithmetic
local currentAllowance is the minuend of the decrease arithmetic
decreaseAllowance updates the _allowances state variable
